# Vennode

Vennode helps people find the right person or group activity. A person publishes a 1-to-1 introduction or a group activity. Someone else reads it and applies with a short note. The host approves or declines. Contact opens only after approval. The product does not auto-match people.

People search in their own words for interests, cities, skills, dating, cofounders, classes, sports, and local activities. Listings are public on the home page and the explore square.

Primary pages:
- / home, latest 1-to-1 posts and group activities
- /create publish a post
- /square browse and send an invite
- /portal/one-to-one posts you host and applications you received
- /portal/groups the same for group activities
